worldTree.skyMethod: Replacement masks: foliage pixels over otherwise visible sky, upper screen half, real gameplay camera at 90m / pitch 8. Look-up captures use the ordinary follow camera.

scope: Automated Windows Player tests, visible native OnGUI captures, original-versus-cutout PNG provenance, localhost three-process co-op. No physical-PC LAN, long manual balance run, full cloth collision solver, or hardware FPS guarantee.

regressionNotes.explanation: Initial root movement run had one blocked=false sample, with all four positions outside the solid hull. The unchanged Player passed all four on repeat. The existing probe uses a random solo seed and wall-clock movement duration; its nondeterminism is not fixed in this update.
